news.title: Fernandes dropped to Man Utd bench - was Carrick right?
news.description: Manchester United skipper Bruno Fernandes is dropped from the starting XI for Sunday's game against Bournemouth following his criticism of manager Michael Carrick.

news.title: When is Premier League 'sacking season' - and who should be worried?
news.description: As pressure builds on Manchester United manager Michael Carrick, BBC Sport looks at when the Premier League 'sacking season' begins.

news.title: What Man Utd need now is stability, not more changes - Pulis
news.description: BBC Sport columnist Tony Pulis explains why Bruno Fernandes' comments after Manchester United's defeat by Como showed how hard it must be to run the club at the moment.

news.title: The candid meeting that 'changed' Spurs - are they finally on way back?
news.description: Tottenham end Saturday's Premier League action in 12th place, their highest league position since 2 January. Are they finally on their way back?

news.title: 'This is the only Clasico' - Mourinho's Real trying to stop Barca's shot at history
news.description: Barcelona aim to make La Liga history against Real Madrid, with Jose Mourinho looking to end their winning run.

news.title: What have Man Utd changed to turn around WSL form?
news.description: It's a different picture at Manchester United now than it was last month - so what have they changed to turn around their WSL form?

news.title: Who am I? Plus today's other quizzes
news.description: Test your ball knowledge against today's Who Am I?, Five in Five and Brainteaser.

news.title: Spurs clinch rare Stamford Bridge win as Palmer sent off
news.description: Tottenham claim just their second victory over Chelsea at Stamford Bridge in 36 years, winning 2-0 as the hosts finish with 10 men after a red card for Cole Palmer.

news.title: Arsenal beat Everton to go level on points with leaders Man City
news.description: Goals from Ezri Konsa, his first for the club, and Gabriel Magalhaes helped Arsenal beat Everton 2-0 at the Emirates to move level on points with league leaders Manchester City.

news.title: Jackson scores twice as Aston Villa end Man City's perfect start
news.description: Nicolas Jackson scores twice as Aston Villa beat Manchester City 2-1 at Villa Park to end their 100% start to the Premier League season.
